name: Read-only collision survey of original crumbling wall passage

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 1280
resolution y = 720
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.05

at 0 command content:oblivion.esm:02466e GetStage
at 0 command dynamic:player:0000000000000001 GetDead

local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local done=false
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function() if done then return end done=true for y=3160,3240,10 do for z=-830,-690,10 do local r=nearby.castRay(util.vector3(250,y,z),util.vector3(550,y,z)) print('Sewer clearance y='..y..' z='..z..' hit='..tostring(r.hit)..' pos='..tostring(r.hitPos)..' object='..tostring(r.hitObject)) end end print('Sewer collision survey complete') end}}}}
